unfrozen_by.instrument_check: B0 all-exact on 50,000 DEV rows across all six targets

purpose: freeze the target set and curriculum contract that V2-0's cue dispositions unblocked. Cells, weights and per-rung intervention lists remain unfrozen.

requestability.restriction: must be reported within strata; a pooled number would partly measure sentence shape and must not be reported as a capability
requestability.caveat: the cue is rendering geometry, not information availability

missing_cardinality.caveat: substantially predictable from bookkeeping counters rather than semantics; a later rung improving on 0.61 may have learned the counter, not the concept

conflict.cannot_be_restrained_by_stratum: the cue scores 1.0 in all eight renderer families, so no stratum exists in which it is absent
conflict.root_cause: renderer artifact, not a semantic property: the report channel is rendered with fixed phrasings that are deterministically coupled to the conflict flag
conflict.prescribed_v3_remedy: decorrelate report phrasing from the conflict label; vary report surface realization independently of whether a conflict exists, so no fixed phrase set predicts the flag

underpowered_no_claim_permitted.rule: strata below 200 DEV rows are UNDERPOWERED and are not scored
underpowered_no_claim_permitted.consistency_note: consistent with v2's own G06 coverage receipt, which required every core action to be non-zero in all six cells - non-zero, not frequent

primary_pressure_target.why_it_matters: the bank's action semantics are formally decidable from the record - B0 does it exactly - yet no cheap cue recovers them. This is the first rung-local evidence that the operationalization stage is a real wall rather than an artefact of an earlier interface.
primary_pressure_target.note: this is the MOVE wall measured as a target

curriculum_contract.axes_binding: the ten frozen capability axes in ff-s15-ladder-scaffold-00, unchanged
curriculum_contract.design_requirement: curriculum must vary capability-axis coverage, not just row count
curriculum_contract.data_axis: A_c(N, k; M, I) - acquisition is plotted against coverage with N as a secondary label
curriculum_contract.current_data_reality: acquisition is SYNTHETIC-ONLY until external root permissions resolve; a synthetic-only curve is a real measurement and must never be described as evidence about human-grounded data

known_positive_signal_to_preserve.finding: B3 lexical (0.0382) scores BELOW the majority baseline (0.0342 is comparable) while B2 schema counts reach 0.4533
known_positive_signal_to_preserve.interpretation: the reason head is not solvable from surface text at all; this is a genuine good property of the bank and the curriculum must not erode it by making reason lexically signalled

render_phrase_decorrelation_required.reason: V2-0 found conflict at 1.0 from four fixed phrases; v3 must not inherit that coupling
render_phrase_decorrelation_required.requirement: report-channel surface realizations must be varied independently of the conflict flag, and the independence must be gate-checked on 100% of rows

bookkeeping_counter_decoupling_recommend.reason: missing_cardinality reached 0.6061 from hidden_facts count alone
bookkeeping_counter_decoupling_recommend.requirement: where feasible, vary the number of hidden non-required facts independently of |M|, so the counter stops being a proxy

v3_synthetic_core_requirements.gate_addition: G19 CUE-INDEPENDENCE: no fixed phrase set predicts any admitted target at or above the V2-0 bar, checked at 100%
v3_synthetic_core_requirements.note: G19 is proposed here and becomes binding when folded into the next constitution amendment

seal_path.problem: the frozen constitution's G14-V3 asserts external_roots_imported > 0, which cannot be satisfied while O1 clears zero sources
seal_path.not_amended_here: changing G14-V3 is a constitution change and is a scientific decision, so it is NOT made in this contract

prepared_for_the_owner.smallest_amendment: split the seal into BANK-v3-core (synthetic only, G14-CORE: external_rows_imported == 0) and BANK-v3-human (external roots, G14-HUMAN provenance gates), so the synthetic core can be sealed now and the human extension sealed later when permissions resolve
prepared_for_the_owner.why_preferable_to_waiting: the synthetic core is a complete, sealable instrument on its own; withholding it until a licensing question resolves elsewhere couples two unrelated risks

still_unfrozen: capability cells and target membership per rung
G19 as a binding gate (proposed above, adopted by the next amendment)
